about.title: About
body: I am Julio, a software engineer with a decade of shipping web products. I like software that feels obvious to use and stays calm to maintain, and I care about the small details that make both true.

Most of the last few years have been one long migration at a travel company, from a legacy framework to a cloud-native platform. That work is where my taste for boring, maintainable systems comes from.

ds.title: Design system
ds.colorNote: Each skin keeps its own accent, used for what is active or actionable. Status colours always come with a glyph and a word.
ds.motionNote: Select a row to play it. Durations drop to zero under prefers-reduced-motion.
ds.skinsNote: Six themes, five of them open-source ports. Each ships a dark and a light palette — the mode is never a setting here, it comes from your device. The two rows under each preview are that theme's dark and light tokens.
ds.resultSample: Result text sits under the tool call.
ds.logoNote: The jl mark: a j followed by a block cursor that doubles as the l. ⠚ is the letter j in Braille, shown only while something loads.
ds.intro: Every token, theme and component on this page is read live from the page itself, so it changes the moment you change the theme.
